words.definition: n. 长沙发；诊榻；v. （以特定方式）表达

examples.en: The invitation was couched in the politest possible terms.
examples.zh: 这份邀请以最礼貌的措辞表达。

examples.en: He spent the whole afternoon dozing on the couch.
examples.zh: 他整个下午都在长沙发上打盹。

words.usage: 习语 couch potato 终日窝在沙发看电视的人；be couched in... terms 以…措辞表述，阅读常见；精神分析语境 lie on the couch 躺上诊榻；与 coach 教练、长途车区分
collocations: be couched in terms 以…措辞表达
lie on the couch 躺在沙发上
words.mnemonic: couch 谐音「靠吃」→ 靠在沙发上吃薯片

words.definition: adv. 向前；向外；露出

examples.en: The team put forth a bold new theory of climate cycles.
examples.zh: 团队提出了一个大胆的气候周期新理论。

examples.en: The ferry moved slowly back and forth across the bay.
examples.zh: 渡轮在海湾里缓缓来回穿行。

words.usage: 只作副词，无比较级；back and forth 来回地；and so forth 等等；put forth 提出、发表；set forth 阐明；bring forth 产生；与 fourth 第四个数字词区分
words.mnemonic: fore 前+th → 向前；fourth 是第四

words.definition: adj. 错综复杂的；精细难懂的

examples.en: The intricate network of canals keeps the city from flooding.
examples.zh: 纵横交错的运河网络保护城市免受洪灾。

examples.en: The watch contains hundreds of intricate moving parts.
examples.zh: 这块手表内含数百个精巧的活动部件。

words.usage: 多形容系统、设计盘根错节：intricate details 繁复细节；比 complex 更强调精细难理清；派生 intricacy n. 错综复杂
collocations: intricate design 复杂精细的设计
words.mnemonic: in+tric（诡计）+ate → 诡计缠身 → 错综复杂

words.definition: v. 登上；增加；发起；n. 山；底座

examples.en: Public pressure is mounting for the minister to resign.
examples.zh: 要求部长辞职的公众压力与日俱增。

examples.en: The firm mounted a legal challenge to the new regulation.
examples.zh: 该公司对新规发起了法律挑战。

words.usage: tension mounts 紧张加剧为阅读高频；mount a challenge 发起挑战；mount up 累积；山名前大写如 Mount Everest；派生 mountain n. 山
collocations: mount a challenge 发起挑战
words.mnemonic: mount 谐音「马骑」→ 骑马上山 → 登上

words.definition: adj. 硬的；僵硬的；生硬的；激烈的；艰难的

examples.en: Graduates face stiff competition for a limited number of jobs.
examples.zh: 毕业生们为有限的岗位展开激烈竞争。

examples.en: My fingers were stiff with cold after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了很长一段路后，我的手指冻僵了。

words.usage: a stiff neck 脖子发僵；stiff competition 激烈竞争为阅读高频；a stiff fine 重罚；习语 keep a stiff upper lip 沉着坚忍（英）
collocations: a stiff penalty 严厉处罚
a stiff neck 僵硬的脖子
words.mnemonic: stiff 谐音「死推不弯夫」→ 硬邦邦 → 僵硬

words.definition: adj. 温暖舒适的；亲切友好的；（关系）暧昧的

examples.en: They spent the snowy evening in a cozy little cafe.
examples.zh: 他们在一个温馨的小咖啡馆里度过了下雪的夜晚。

examples.en: The regulator had a cozy relationship with the industry it oversaw.
examples.zh: 监管机构与其监管的行业关系过于暧昧。

words.usage: a cozy room 温馨的房间；贬义 a cozy relationship 暧昧关系为阅读考点；cozy up to sb 讨好（口语）；英式拼法 cosy
collocations: a cozy room 温馨的房间
cozy up to sb 巴结某人
a cozy relationship 暧昧关系
words.mnemonic: cozy 谐音「靠椅」→ 靠在椅子上很舒适

words.definition: adj. 熟的；成熟的；时机成熟的

examples.en: The time is ripe for a thorough reform of the tax system.
examples.zh: 税制全面改革的时机已经成熟。

examples.en: The branches were heavy with ripe golden pears.
examples.zh: 树枝被金黄的熟梨压弯了。

words.usage: 果实成熟：ripe apples 熟苹果；the time is ripe for sth 时机成熟为高频；a ripe old age 高寿；派生 ripen v. 成熟
collocations: the time is ripe 时机成熟
be ripe for sth …的时机成熟
words.mnemonic: 比 rip 多个 e → 多一分火候 → 熟了

words.definition: n. 对应的人（或物）；职位相当者

examples.en: The Chinese official will meet his American counterpart next week.
examples.zh: 中方官员下周将会见美方对等官员。

examples.en: The Foreign Secretary discussed the trade deal with his French counterpart.
examples.zh: 外交大臣与法国外长讨论了贸易协定。

words.usage: 可数名词，指职能、地位相对应的另一方：one's counterpart in/abroad 某人在别处的对应者；译法灵活：对等官员、同行、另一方；法律文本中指合同副本、对应本
collocations: meet one's counterpart 会见对等官员
one's counterpart abroad 海外同行
words.mnemonic: counter 对应+part 部分 → 对应的那一方

words.definition: n. 两星期；十四天

examples.en: The committee will publish its findings in a fortnight's time.
examples.zh: 委员会将在两周后公布调查结果。

examples.en: They rent a cottage by the sea for a fortnight each summer.
examples.zh: 他们每年夏天在海边租一间小屋住两周。

words.usage: 英式常用，美式多说 two weeks；a fortnight's holiday 两周假期；every fortnight 每两周；派生 fortnightly adj. 双周的
collocations: a fortnight's holiday 两周假期
words.mnemonic: fort=fourteen 十四夜 → 十四天

words.definition: adj. 亲密的；私人的；详尽的；n. 密友；v. 暗示

examples.en: Only his closest intimates knew about his struggle with illness.
examples.zh: 只有最亲密的挚友知道他与病魔抗争的事。

examples.en: She has an intimate knowledge of European trade law.
examples.zh: 她对欧洲贸易法了如指掌。

words.usage: adj. be intimate with sb 与…亲密；intimate knowledge 精通；v. 读 ɪnˈtɪmeɪt，intimate that 暗示；派生 intimacy n. 亲密
words.mnemonic: intim（最内）+ate → 贴到心里 → 亲密

words.definition: v. 渴望；追求；有志于

examples.en: Young researchers aspire to publish in leading journals.
examples.zh: 年轻研究者渴望在顶级期刊上发表论文。

examples.en: She aspired to a career in public service from an early age.
examples.zh: 她从早年起就立志从事公共服务。

words.usage: aspire to sth 渴望得到；aspire to do sth 渴望做某事；正式用语，多接远大目标；派生 aspiration n. 抱负
collocations: aspire to do sth 渴望做某事
aspire to higher office 渴望高升
aspiring artists 有抱负的艺术家
words.mnemonic: a 向+spire（呼吸）→ 对目标喘气追赶 → 渴望

words.definition: n. 侧面（像）；轮廓；简介；形象；v. 概述；写传略

examples.en: The company keeps a low profile despite its huge profits.
examples.zh: 这家公司尽管利润惊人，却保持低调。

examples.en: The magazine ran a profile of the reclusive novelist.
examples.zh: 杂志刊登了一篇关于这位隐居小说家的人物特写。

words.usage: keep a low profile 保持低调，高频短语；a high-profile case 备受关注的案件；customer profile 客户画像；派生 profiling n. 画像分析
collocations: keep a low profile 保持低调
a high-profile case 高关注度案件
a profile of sb 某人小传
words.mnemonic: pro 前+file 线条 → 勾出前侧线条 → 侧面像

words.definition: n. 人质

examples.en: The militants threatened to kill the hostages unless their demands were met.
examples.zh: 武装分子威胁说，若要求得不到满足就杀害人质。

examples.en: Two journalists were held hostage for over a year.
examples.zh: 两名记者被扣为人质一年多。

words.usage: hold sb hostage 扣押人质；take sb hostage 劫持人质；release the hostages 释放人质；派生 hostage-taker n. 劫持者
collocations: hold sb hostage 扣押人质
release the hostages 释放人质
words.mnemonic: host 客人+age → 被扣当「客人」→ 人质

words.definition: adj. 最重要的；最先的；adv. 首先；居于首位

examples.en: He is widely regarded as the foremost authority on ancient scripts.
examples.zh: 他被公认为古文字研究的最高权威。

examples.en: First and foremost, the plan must protect small investors.
examples.zh: 首先，该方案必须保护小投资者。

words.usage: first and foremost 首要的是，作文常用；the foremost authority 最高权威；已含 most，不再加 most 构成比较级
collocations: first and foremost 首要的是
the foremost authority 最高权威
one of the foremost concerns 主要关切之一
words.mnemonic: fore 前+most 最 → 排在最前 → 首要的

words.definition: adj. 中空的；空洞的；凹陷的；n. 洼地；洞

examples.en: The government's promises turned out to be hollow words.
examples.zh: 政府的承诺最终成了空话。

examples.en: The cottages nestled in a hollow surrounded by pine woods.
examples.zh: 村舍坐落在松林环绕的洼地里。

words.usage: a hollow tree 中空的树；hollow promises 空洞的承诺为引申高频；hollow cheeks 凹陷的双颊；hollow out 挖空；派生 hollowness n. 空洞
words.mnemonic: hollow 谐音「哈喽洞」→ 喊一声空空回响 → 中空

words.definition: n. 罗盘；指南针；圆规；范围

examples.en: Without a compass, the hikers lost their way in the dense fog.
examples.zh: 没有指南针，徒步者在浓雾中迷了路。

examples.en: Such questions fall outside the compass of this small study.
examples.zh: 这些问题超出了这项小型研究的范围。

words.usage: 圆规义常用复数 a pair of compasses；引申义 beyond the compass of 超出范围；moral compass 道德准则；派生 encompass v. 包含
collocations: a compass needle 罗盘指针
beyond the compass of 超出…范围
words.mnemonic: com 共同+pass 通过 → 一起找通路 → 罗盘指方向

words.definition: n. 坟墓；陵墓

examples.en: Archaeologists unearthed a royal tomb filled with bronze vessels.
examples.zh: 考古学家发掘出一座满是青铜器的王室陵墓。

examples.en: Tourists lined up to visit the ancient tombs in the valley.
examples.zh: 游客排队参观山谷里的古墓群。

words.usage: 字母 b 不发音，与 bomb、comb 同为哑音 b 词；excavate a tomb 发掘古墓；the Unknown Soldier 无名烈士墓；派生 tombstone n. 墓碑
words.mnemonic: tomb 谐音「土墓」→ 土堆之墓；b 不发音

words.definition: n. 少数；少数民族；未成年（期）

examples.en: Only a small minority of voters opposed the reform bill.
examples.zh: 只有一小部分选民反对该改革法案。

examples.en: The state guarantees educational rights for ethnic minorities.
examples.zh: 国家保障少数民族的受教育权。

words.usage: a minority of 少数…，谓语单复数随 of 后名词；be in the minority 占少数；minority shareholders 小股东为高频；反义 majority
collocations: a minority of 一小部分
words.mnemonic: minor 较小+ity → 占少数的一方 → 少数

words.definition: n. 评价，估价；评估，鉴定

examples.en: The bank requires an independent appraisal of the property before approving the loan.
examples.zh: 银行在批准贷款前要求对房产进行独立估价。

examples.en: Regular performance appraisals help employees identify their weaknesses.
examples.zh: 定期绩效评估有助于员工认清自身不足。

words.usage: 常用 make an appraisal of（对…作出评估）；绩效考核说 performance appraisal。派生：appraise vt. 评价；appraiser n. 估价师。

confusables.note: 表扬；缺 ap 前缀，勿混

collocations: make an appraisal of 对…作出评估
words.mnemonic: ap+prais(价值)+al→评定价值→估价；与praise同源

words.definition: adj. 外交的；有手腕的，圆滑的

examples.en: The two countries resumed diplomatic relations after decades of hostility.
examples.zh: 两国在数十年敌对之后恢复了外交关系。

examples.en: She gave a diplomatic answer to avoid offending either side.
examples.zh: 她给出了一个圆滑得体的回答，以免得罪任何一方。

words.usage: 「外交的」见 diplomatic relations（外交关系）；形容人圆滑得体也用它：be diplomatic about sth。派生：diplomacy n. 外交；diplomat n. 外交官。

synonyms.note: 侧重言行得体、不得罪人

words.mnemonic: diplomat(外交官)+ic→外交的；引申圆滑得体的
